craft_playbook: Deliver the hook inside 2.5 seconds; viewers decide in under 2 on mobile.
Open with a pattern interrupt or curiosity gap; NEVER context/build-up or greetings.
Reverse structure: lead with the payoff (news, boldest number, verdict tease), explain after.
Include a concrete number in the hook when possible (price, 0-100, sales figure).
No dead air: trim silences; keep delivery slightly faster than conversational.
Bury nothing: the best moment goes first, not 15 seconds in.
One idea per beat; cut visuals every 2-3 seconds; open on motion or high-contrast frame.
End with a question that begs a comment + a loop-friendly closer (last line can feed the first).
Hook and content must match; clickbait mismatch kills retention and trust.
Front-load value beats: price/verdict by the midpoint, never last.

NEVER recycle a joke or catchphrase across videos — banned as overused: 'how is this even legal', '<rival> owners are sweating', 'means business', 'game-changer'. Each video needs its OWN fresh, specific, Indian-relatable humor (potholes, speed breakers, family weddings, the neighbour, EMIs).

Write for the SPOKEN voiceover: say 'driver-assist' not ADAS, 'four-wheel-drive' not 4XPLOR, 'low-range' not 4-Low, 'Newton-metres' not Nm. Short, easy-to-pronounce, easy-to-understand lines — no dense technical strings. Acronyms/short forms belong ONLY in on-screen pops (read, not spoken).
data_learnings: [high][mechanic][vision-fp-2026-08] Vision blocking is TIERED to cut false positives without weakening safety: readable_plate + watermark_or_logo_overlay HARD-block on a single frame (owner rule — plates blurred/excluded, never ripped/watermarked), but wrong_vehicle_type needs corroboration (>=2 frames of the SAME clip) before it quarantines — a car/aircraft glimpsed in ONE sampled frame (e.g. a helicopter through the Sierra's sunroof, a passing car, a reflection) is advisory, not a block. Implemented in quality/vqa.py blocking_fails(); autoloop + qa consume the corrected blocking_detail unchanged.

[high][process][step5-2026-08] Workflows are codified as SKILLS (charters/skills/*.md) — a charter says WHO an agent is, a skill says HOW to run one workflow (exact `carshorts ...` commands + gates). `carshorts skills` lists them; the headless agent auto-routes a task to the matching skill by trigger keywords and follows its steps verbatim (agents/skills.py route+compose_prompt), so it stops re-deriving (and drifting) the procedure each run. Add a new workflow as a skill, not as tribal knowledge. Seed set: source-footage, produce-video, ground-facts, publish-video, close-the-loop.

[high][process][step4-2026-08] Before rendering a car, run `carshorts footage <slug>` (footageplan): it reports clean distinct clips vs cuts (one clip per cut — the no-repeat rule), a per-angle histogram, missing essential angles (front/side/rear/interior/action), and any clip with NO cleared source in footage_sources.json/attributions.json. A footage-blocked render must surface this shopping list — not a vague 'needs footage'. The Tata Sierra proved it: after the vision gate pulled 4 plated/watermarked ad clips, only 4 clean clips remained (missing side+rear), all with unverified provenance.

[high][process][step4-2026-08] Provenance is a hard licensing gate, not paperwork: never let clips with unknown source sit in a car's own/ pool. `ingest` records source+licence to footage_sources.json; ripped/watermarked ad footage (readable plates, burned-in 'creative representation only' disclaimers — e.g. the Tata Sierra promo) is refused. Two free, no-attribution stock-video APIs (Pexels + Pixabay) via build_video_source() give resilience without paid spend.

[high][process][mg-hawk-2026-08] LEAD with real/press footage; concept stock (especially of OTHER cars) must NEVER lead a video — a stock "highway" clip put plated Mercedes G-Wagons in an MG hook. Vet fetched stock at FULL-RES for readable PLATES and RIVAL BADGES (a small thumbnail grid hid both). For an unreleased car with no real footage, pin the owner clips to hook/spec/value via a shot plan and let concept b-roll fill only peak/cta.

[high][data][sierra-2026-08-03] FRAME 1 = MOTION, not a static card. Sierra's swipe-away was high (only ~23% stayed when it hit the feed). The hero number STAYS in the hook (proven winner), but the FIRST visible frame must be the car MOVING or a bold hero exterior — never a static badge/interior/price-card cold-open. A boring frame 1 loses the swipe before a single word is heard. The price belongs in the spoken line + an overlay punch, not as the opening image.

[high][data][sierra-2026-08-03] MID-POINT is the cliff. Sierra held ~48% (12s of 25s) with the drop at the spec->verdict handoff. Bridge that seam with a one-beat mini-cliffhanger BEFORE the value/peak ('but here's the catch', 'the best bit is the price') so the payoff beat reads as a reveal, not a topic switch. Never let 'specs' and 'the deal' feel like two separate videos stapled together.

[high][data][sierra-2026-08-03] TIGHT OUTRO. Sierra spent ~5-6s on the CTA tail; that dead air at the end drags average-view-% down and delays the loop. Keep the CTA <=4s: fast 'like, share, subscribe' + a <=8-word rivalry poll, then a loop-friendly last line that feeds the hook. A punchy 3s close beats a polite 6s one.

[high][data][sierra-2026-08-03] EVERY NAMED FEATURE gets a synced on-screen overlay at the exact word. Sierra narrated 'Dolby sound' with NO on-screen overlay (the sunroof got one, audio didn't) - the brain critic caught it, deterministic QA did not. If a beat names two features, it needs two pops. Naked feature mentions waste the muted-viewer's eyes and the retention beat.

[high][mechanic][overlays-2026-08-03] Overlays went PREMIUM: retired the heavy Montserrat-Black + tech-cyan + thick meme-stroke look. Two selectable themes, auto-alternated per render for an A/B test (produce --overlay-theme luxe|frost|auto; recorded in manifest render.overlay_theme). A 'luxe' = thin/light weight, wide letter-spacing, boxless, champagne accent (owner's pick). B 'frost' = semibold in a smoked-glass panel, champagne rule. Both: generous TRACKING (the amateur->pro tell), ONE metallic accent (champagne #DEC58C, never cyan/yellow), no heavy stroke. When comparing performance, read overlay_theme from each video's manifest and attribute retention to the look.

[high][mechanic][overlays-2026-08-03] Count-up card bugfix: a unit label ('₹11.49L · EX-SHOWROOM') must NEVER share the giant number line — it clips off both frame edges. The card now splits on '·' into a small tracked kicker + the big value, and hard-clamps the value width to the safe box. Keep card 'show' text as VALUE · LABEL and the engine handles the split.

[high] Avoid long spec-heavy beats: The 'spec' beat consistently shows the largest drop-off (e.g., Kia Sonet 64.9%, Mahindra Scorpio-N 55.1%, Tata Punch 57.1%). Keep spec sections under 5 seconds or weave specs into the value/peak beats.

[high] For comparison videos, ensure all referenced footage (e.g., 'creta_interior.mp4', 'creta_front.mp4') is in the pool before rendering. If missing, the render falls back to mismatched stock footage, causing QA failures and likely confusing viewers.

[medium] When a hook is a question (e.g., 'Worth it?', 'Wait... how?!'), it performs better in early retention (e.g., Kia Sonet 1556 views vs. news hooks like Creta 244 views). Prefer question hooks over news/statement hooks for higher initial engagement.

[medium] Keep video duration short: Videos with word count 58-71 (e.g., Sierra vs Creta, Kia Sonet) tend to have higher average view percentage than longer ones. Trim scripts to under 80 words to maintain retention.

[high] Ensure overlay anchors are spoken clearly and early in the beat to avoid dropped overlays (e.g., '13-SPKR JBL' and 'PANORAMIC ROOF' were dropped). Script writer should match overlay text to spoken words exactly and place them at the start of the beat.

[high] Avoid looping footage: When a clip is shorter than the beat duration, it loops, which is a QA failure. Renderer should either trim the beat to the clip length or select a longer clip. For example, 'sierra_hero.mp4' is 5.2s but used for 6.2s.
